description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {C}{C}.
When Hornet Queen dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Hornet Queen enters, it triggers, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
